structural_blocker: The accepted bank fixes the information available to every algorithm; the frozen TabICLv2 reference plus the classical pool bracket the Bayes-optimal ranking under that information to within ~1e-4. An algorithm-only change can only reduce estimation variance, whose ceiling (~1e-4) is at or below the per-split noise (~5e-4), so no algorithm-only technique can satisfy the 7-split all-positive gate. The four previously strict-passing algorithm schemes (pv_bce/pv_rank/offset2/pan) relied on the provenance information (~+0.002, 10x larger).
